task_understanding: Create formulas in cells P2:P7 that return the column header(s) of the smallest value greater than zero in each row. When multiple columns share the minimum value above zero, concatenate their headers with commas (no spaces). The data spans columns B through N, with headers in row 1.
proposed_approach: For each row (2-7), create a TEXTJOIN formula that concatenates column headers
Use IF(AND(cell=min_value, cell>0), header, '') for each data column (B-N)
TEXTJOIN with comma delimiter and TRUE for ignore_empty will handle multiple matches
The minimum value >0 is already calculated in column O, so reference that cell
Use absolute row references for headers ($B$1) and relative references for data cells
assumptions: Column O already contains the correct minimum value greater than zero for each row
Data columns to check are B through N (columns 2-14)
Empty strings, null values, and zeros should be excluded from consideration
Headers are in row 1, data rows are 2-7
observed_feedback: Input workbook has Sheet1 with dimensions A1:P7
Row 1 contains headers: Product name, Amazon, HN, Catch, Costco, DJ, THX, H, KWH, MBX, MMX, MY, POK, VB, Min Price > 0, Seller
Rows 2-7 contain product data with various numeric values, zeros, empty strings, and nulls
Column O (Min Price > 0) already shows calculated minimum values
Column P (Seller) is currently null and needs to be populated with formulas
known_risks: TEXTJOIN may not be available in older LibreOffice versions, but 26.8.0.3 should support it
Floating point comparison (cell=min_value) might have precision issues, but since we're comparing against pre-calculated values in column O, this should work
Empty cells vs zero vs empty string handling - the AND condition checks both equality to min and >0 to ensure proper filtering
